name: Financial Services - Banking
summary: Retail, commercial, and investment banking. Splunk replacement, fraud, and DORA-aligned regulatory reporting.

personas.pain: Audit-grade SIEM at half the cost of Splunk Enterprise, with full DORA traceability.
Trade-system latency under 5ms with end-to-end distributed tracing.
FRTB, PCI DSS, DORA evidence collection without 3 weeks of manual lift.
Detect account takeover and credential stuffing in under 90 seconds, not 90 minutes.

elastic_wins_when: The customer is over Splunk capacity costs OR needs DORA-aligned cyber resilience OR runs trade systems where latency budgets are micro-seconds.
elastic_loses_when: The SOC has standardized on a competing XDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne) and is unwilling to dual-stack.

name: Financial Services - Insurance
summary: P&C, life, and reinsurance carriers. Claims fraud detection, actuarial search, and Solvency II reporting.

personas.pain: Catch claims fraud rings across policy, vehicle, and provider data in one query.
Sub-second search across 15 years of policy data for catastrophe modeling.
NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law evidence on demand.
Score risk using 3rd-party signals at quote time, not 24 hours later.

elastic_wins_when: The carrier needs a single search layer for claims, policy, and 3rd-party risk data OR is running an aging Splunk SIEM at unsustainable cost.
elastic_loses_when: The customer is fully on Guidewire DataHub and Predict, with no appetite for an external search layer.

name: Financial Services - Capital Markets
summary: Investment banks, broker-dealers, exchanges, hedge funds. Trade surveillance, market data search, and FRTB.

personas.pain: Spoofing and layering detection on T+0 across 40 venues.
Tick-level history search across 7 years for back-testing in seconds.
FRTB IMA daily PnL attribution and ES calculation under regulatory deadlines.
MNPI access logging with provable chain of custody for SEC and FINRA.

elastic_wins_when: The firm needs surveillance plus observability on the same platform, OR is rebuilding a kdb+ or proprietary tick store and cost is the driver.
elastic_loses_when: Trade surveillance is locked into Nasdaq SMARTS or NICE Actimize and there is no consolidation budget this fiscal year.

name: Government - Federal
summary: US federal civilian and DoD agencies. FedRAMP-aligned SIEM, mission observability, FOIA-ready archive.

personas.pain: M-21-31 logging tier 3 across all agency endpoints inside FY budget.
Continuous ATO with evidence pulled directly from telemetry, not slide decks.
FedRAMP High and IL5 deployment with the same code path as commercial.
FOIA-grade archive search across 7 years of agency communications.

elastic_wins_when: The agency is on Splunk MOOSE and renewal is squeezing the mission budget, OR is on a CDM dashboard mandate that needs faster search.
elastic_loses_when: The agency has a sole-source Splunk Cloud GovCloud BPA with multi-year remaining and no executive sponsor for change.

name: Government - State and Local
summary: States, counties, cities, and education. Shared services SIEM, 311 search, election security.

personas.pain: StateRAMP-aligned SOC running on a budget that does not get bigger every year.
Citizen-facing search (DMV, benefits, 311) that does not melt during peak.
Ballot logistics and poll-site telemetry with auditable retention.
Student safety signals across LMS, email, and chat with FERPA boundaries.

elastic_wins_when: The agency is consolidating from a patchwork of free or open-source tools (ELK self-managed, Graylog) and wants vendor support, OR Splunk renewal is impossible.
elastic_loses_when: The state has a Microsoft E5 G5 EA and Sentinel is essentially free at the margin.

name: Healthcare - Providers
summary: Hospitals, IDNs, ambulatory networks. EHR observability, HIPAA SOC, clinical search across notes.

personas.pain: Search across 10 years of clinical notes (Epic, Cerner) without exporting PHI to a third party.
HIPAA and HITRUST SOC at half the headcount.
Epic Hyperspace login and chart-open latency under 2 seconds.
Denials root cause across claims, eligibility, and EHR in one search.

kpis.metric: Clinical search recall on free-text notes

elastic_wins_when: The IDN runs Epic and needs a search layer that respects PHI boundaries, OR Splunk is being pushed out by IT finance.
elastic_loses_when: Epic Cogito and Caboodle are funded and the customer believes those cover analytics needs.

name: Healthcare - Payers
summary: Health plans, PBMs, TPAs. Member portal search, fraud waste and abuse, prior auth observability.

personas.pain: Prior-auth turnaround inside CMS interoperability deadlines.

elastic_wins_when: The plan is rebuilding member-facing search and needs vector plus lexical, OR consolidating SIEM and observability after an M&A.
elastic_loses_when: The carrier is fully on Optum Insight and SAS Detection and Investigation and has no break-glass appetite.

elastic_loses_when: Veeva Vault is the system of record for everything regulated and the customer wants no parallel search layer.
